steps.action: Show the screen at the front desk
must_not: A plan that ended shown as active

steps.action: A pass member opens My membership
A member with a renewal paid in advance opens it

steps.action: A member whose plan ended opens it
user_sees: 'Your plan has ended', 'Renew at the desk to keep training.'
